title: FastQuery: Communication-efficient Embedding Table Query for Private LLMs inference
problem: Private inference using homomorphic encryption requires embedding table queries to be formulated as HE-based matrix-vector multiplication, suffering from enormous computation and communication overhead.
motivation: As LLMs evolve, protecting user query privacy is critical since queries may contain sensitive information.
method: FastQuery proposes a communication-aware embedding table quantization algorithm and a one-hot-aware dense packing algorithm that jointly reduce computation and communication costs. The approach exploits the one-hot nature of embedding lookups and the robustness of embedding tables to low bit-width quantization in HE-based private inference.
key_novelty: Exploiting one-hot structure of embedding queries combined with communication-aware quantization to achieve simultaneous computation and communication reduction in HE-based private LLM inference.
contributions: Communication-aware embedding table quantization algorithm leveraging robustness to low bit-width noise
One-hot-aware dense packing algorithm exploiting query structure
4.3×-75.7× speedup and communication improvements over prior HE-based frameworks
Demonstration on LLAMA-7B and LLAMA-30B showing practical impact

metrics.speedup: 4.3× vs Cheetah, 2.7× vs Iron, 1.3× vs Bumblebee
metrics.other: 75.7× communication reduction vs Cheetah, 60.2× vs Iron, 20.2× vs Bumblebee
